name: The Golem
palette: Muted earthy palette of wet clay browns, slate greys and moss greens, with warm rust-orange and amber accents.
character: THE GOLEM: a hulking, hunched construct made of muddy river clay and rough mossy boulders, held together by rusted iron bands and rivets, dripping wet mud, a single glowing amber ember-eye in a boulder head, cracks in its body glowing faintly orange.
icon_subject: the boulder head of the Golem with its glowing amber eye, front view
portrait: full portrait of the Golem standing, menacing but loyal, in a misty cave
banner: The Golem standing heroically on a pile of rubble at the base of a dark spire, looking up

overrides.strike_golem: Close-up of the Golem's clay arm entering from the lower left edge, ending in a huge boulder fist bound by a rusted iron wrist band, mossy stone with glowing orange cracks, punching diagonally up to the right. A small burst of rock chips and mud at the knuckles. Background: rust red with darker brown angular streaks.
overrides.defend_golem: The Golem crouching behind its raised boulder forearm like a shield, sparks bouncing off the stone.
overrides.slam: The Golem slamming both fists into the ground, shockwave of mud and rock shards.
overrides.clay_arms: Close-up of a freshly sculpted pair of wet clay arms with iron rivets, held up as if just attached, finger marks visible in the clay.
overrides.rockslide: A tumbling wave of boulders and mud cascading down a slope onto shadowy enemies.
overrides.boulder_toss: The Golem hurling a giant round boulder overhead, mid-throw, dynamic angle from below.
overrides.mudslinger: A glob of thick dark mud flying through the air, splattering onto a monster's face.
overrides.pebble_barrage: A spray of dozens of small stones and pebbles flying out of the Golem's open palm like shrapnel.
overrides.stone_skin: The Golem's clay chest hardening into overlapping grey stone plates, flakes of dried mud falling away.
overrides.packed_earth: A thick wall of tightly packed layered earth and roots rising up in front of the Golem.
overrides.assemble: Floating golem body parts (a boulder head, clay arms, rusty iron legs) being pulled together by glowing amber threads.
overrides.full_body_slam: The Golem leaping and crashing body-first onto an enemy, its whole massive form in the air, debris everywhere.
overrides.boulder_fists: Two enormous fists made of round river boulders bound with rusted chains, one punching forward.
overrides.lantern_eye: A boulder head with a single huge glowing lantern-like amber eye casting a beam of warm light into darkness.
overrides.rooted_legs: Thick clay legs sinking into the ground, sprouting gnarled roots that anchor deep into the soil.
overrides.mud_core: A pulsing heart-shaped ball of dark wet mud inside an open stone chest cavity, oozing slowly.
overrides.collapse: The Golem crumbling apart on purpose, its parts falling into a protective heap of rubble over itself.
overrides.tremor: The ground cracking in a spiderweb pattern beneath several staggering monsters, dust rising, Golem stomping in the background.
overrides.lend_a_hand: A huge clay hand gently shielding a small hooded adventurer from incoming arrows.
overrides.furnace_core: A roaring iron furnace glowing white-orange inside the Golem's cracked chest, embers and steam pouring out.
overrides.avalanche: A colossal avalanche of boulders, mud and snow thundering down a mountainside onto a horde of enemies, epic scale.
overrides.clay_arms_power: a single wet clay fist with an iron rivet
overrides.boulder_fists_power: a fist made of a round grey boulder wrapped in a rusty chain
overrides.lantern_eye_power: a glowing amber eye set in a rough stone
overrides.rooted_legs_power: a clay foot with roots growing from its sole
overrides.mud_core_power: a dripping ball of dark mud shaped like a heart
overrides.furnace_core_power: a small glowing iron furnace with an orange flame
overrides.heart_of_clay: a lumpy heart sculpted from reddish-brown river clay, with thumbprints and a faint orange glow from inside
